subject.title: [codex] Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical setup-code native bootstrap identity?
rationale: The code looks narrow and proven, but it changes which remote native node identities can skip owner approval during setup-code bootstrap and receive a bounded operator handoff token; that is a maintainer-owned product/security boundary, not a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity
options.body: Accept this client id and metadata shape as the current canonical Even Hub glasses bootstrap seam, then require the contributor to resolve the merge conflict and keep the spoof tests/proof intact.

options.title: Rename or generalize first
options.body: Ask for a generation-neutral client id or different stable metadata before merge, while preserving the same tested bootstrap gate shape.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Leave Even Hub on generic node-host/owner approval paths until the broader companion-app ownership and security model is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity
recommendation.body: Accept this client id and metadata shape as the current canonical Even Hub glasses bootstrap seam, then require the contributor to resolve the merge conflict and keep the spoof tests/proof intact.
